v3_grouped_holdout.evaluation: mAP@50, full-image-box eval, on FROZEN supplier-grouped holdout (vision/data/split_v1.json): no two images from the same source page split across train/test
v3_grouped_holdout.model: yolov8n fine-tuned (30 epochs, lr0=0.003), imgsz 320, train 242 / test 55
honest_caveats: This is NOT overall accuracy: it is mAP@50 on a whole-image-box detection eval, on a frozen grouped holdout.
Per-class test counts range 1-5 images; classes with 1 test image (brass, steel_scrap, sand, mdf, wood_zan, gravel) have noisy per-class AP.
Below 0.5 AP50 on this holdout: brick_white (0.495), wood_zan (0.497). brass/steel_scrap/aluminum_shavings pass on this split but remain data-starved (5-6 train images).
Split is frozen in split_v1.json; future harvested images extend train only.
